description: This file is a PHP script for deleting test case scripts in the TestLink open source testing platform. It handles HTTP request parameters, initializes environment, checks user permissions, and performs database deletion of test case script links based on provided identifiers.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Anonymous generic object used for storing properties, such as GUI and configuration data.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and arguments from request parameters, sets up GUI context, and retrieves code tracker configuration.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves code tracker interface object and configuration for a specific test project.

methods.name: del_testcase_script
methods.description: Deletes test case script link entries from the database based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to modify test cases.
